facts.text: The hotel sits in the Beichen Delta of Kaifu District, where the Xiang River and Liuyang River converge.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Changsha sits prominently in the Beichen Delta of Kaifu District, where the Xiang River and Liuyang River converge.

facts.text: The hotel is four metro stops from Wuyi Square, the city's commercial heart.
facts.excerpt: is just four metro stops from Wuyi Square, the city's vibrant commercial heart.

facts.text: The Three Halls and One Center cultural complex and the Beichen Hui commercial hub are within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: with the Three Halls and One Center cultural complex and Beichen Hui commercial hub within easy walking distance.

facts.text: The hotel has a cruiser-style facade and a 27-metre-high atrium, combining international design with the cultural heritage of Hunan.
facts.excerpt: Combining the essence of the world's designers and the cultural heritage of Hunan, hotel cruiser façade and 27m high atrium

facts.text: Rooms are contemporary in design and styled with local cultural flair.
facts.excerpt: All rooms are contemporarily designed, elegantly furnished and styled with local cultural flair.

facts.text: Each room has a marble bathtub and a separate walk-in rainforest shower.
facts.excerpt: luxurious marble bathtub and separate walk-in rainforest shower

facts.text: Guest rooms offer views of the Xiangjiang River.

facts.text: Some Premium Rooms have a kids theme.
